label: fixed_pair_step_scale_v1
contract: Causal diagnostic of observed fixed-input localization oscillation. Same actual new checkpoint, head weights/Adam state, cached input features, BF16, targets and loss. Both ranks update only the current position head; second rank changes only diagnostic step size to0.1x. Formal peakLR1e-4 remains unchanged. Also compare train/eval outputs at identical weights and analytic final-bias L1 gradient. No architecture changes, no reuse of diagnostic weights, no formal promotion.
